nodes.description: Private owner address of UniswapExchange, set to msg.sender in the constructor and used as the sole access-control gate.
Public mapping(address=>uint) balanceOf; mutated without SafeMath in transferFrom, _mints and batchSend.
Public mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) allowance; written by approve and decremented unchecked in transferFrom.
Public totalSupply of the token, set in the constructor.
Private mapping _onSaleNum tracking per-address sale count, incremented in transferFrom and read in condition.
Private mapping canSale whitelisting addresses; read in ensure and set to true in _mints.
Private _minSale minimum sale threshold set by init and enforced in condition.
Private _maxSale maximum sale threshold set by init and enforced in condition.
Private _saleNum maximum number of sales per address set by init and enforced in condition.
Address tradeAddress whitelisted in ensure and set by setTradeAddress.
Constant UNI router address 0x7a250d5630B4cF539739dF2C5dAcb4c659F2488D compared against in ensure().
msg.sender: the only external caller-controlled value used in this contract, driving authorization checks and transfer ownership.
UniswapExchange constructor(string _name,string _symbol,uint256 _supply) payable: sets name, symbol, totalSupply, owner=msg.sender, initial balance and unlimited allowance to the UNI router.
transfer(address _to,uint _value) public payable: delegates to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
transferFrom(address _from,address _to,uint _value) public payable: checks allowance, calls ensure(), then mutates balanceOf and _onSaleNum with raw unchecked arithmetic.
ensure(address _from,address _to,uint _value) internal view: whitelist gate comparing against owner, UNI, tradeAddress and canSale, otherwise calls condition().
approve(address _spender,uint _value) public payable: writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
condition(address _from,uint _value) internal view: enforces _saleNum, _minSale and _maxSale limits.
delegate(address a,bytes memory b) public payable: owner-only function performing an arbitrary delegatecall to a with attacker-controlled calldata.
_mints(address spender,uint256 addedValue) public: owner or hardcoded-address gated arbitrary balance assignment and canSale whitelisting.
init(uint256 saleNum,uint256 token,uint256 maxToken) public: owner-only setter of _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum sale limits.
batchSend(address[] _tos,uint _value) public payable: owner-only batch transfer computing total = _value * _tos.length without SafeMath.
setTradeAddress(address addr) public: owner-only setter of the tradeAddress whitelist entry.
pairFor(address factory,address tokenA,address tokenB) internal pure: deterministic Uniswap pair address computation via keccak256.
Arbitrary delegatecall: a.delegatecall(b) executes attacker-supplied code in the token's storage context.
Unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom: allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value, balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value bypass SafeMath.
Unchecked arithmetic in batchSend: uint total = _value * _tos.length and balanceOf updates without SafeMath.
Arbitrary mint in _mints: balanceOf[spender] = addedValue*(10**decimals) with no supply accounting and a bypassable hardcoded address gate.
Parameter _to of transfer(): recipient address.
Parameter _value of transfer(): amount forwarded to transferFrom.
Parameter _spender of approve(): allowance grantee.
Parameter _value of approve(): allowance amount written.
Parameter _from of transferFrom(): debited account, checked against msg.sender.
Parameter _to of transferFrom(): credited account.
Parameter _value of transferFrom(): amount used in unchecked subtraction and addition.
Parameter _from of ensure(): whitelist subject.
Parameter _to of ensure(): compared against owner.
Parameter _value of ensure(): forwarded to condition().
Parameter _from of condition(): indexed into _onSaleNum.
Parameter _value of condition(): compared against _minSale and _maxSale.
Parameter a of delegate(): raw delegatecall target address.
Parameter b of delegate(): raw delegatecall calldata bytes.
Parameter spender of _mints(): account that receives an arbitrary balance.
Parameter addedValue of _mints(): raw balance amount assigned without supply accounting.
Parameter saleNum of init(): assigns _saleNum.
Parameter token of init(): assigns _minSale.
Parameter maxToken of init(): assigns _maxSale.
Parameter _tos of batchSend(): recipient array whose length drives the unchecked total.
Parameter _value of batchSend(): multiplied by _tos.length without SafeMath.
Local uint total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend (unchecked multiplication).
Local loop index i in batchSend.
Local address _to in batchSend, credited via balanceOf[_to] += _value.
Parameter addr of setTradeAddress(): stored into tradeAddress whitelist.
Parameter factory of pairFor(): Uniswap factory address.
Parameter tokenA of pairFor().
Parameter tokenB of pairFor().
Local pair address computed by pairFor().
Parameter _name of the constructor: token name.
Parameter _symbol of the constructor: token symbol.
Parameter _supply of the constructor: initial supply multiplier.

approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Constructor sets owner = msg.sender, the root of all authorization.
_mints requires msg.sender == owner or the hardcoded address.
init requires msg.sender == owner.
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner.
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender == owner.
delegate requires msg.sender == owner before executing the delegatecall.
transfer forwards execution to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
transferFrom calls ensure(_from,_to,_value) before mutating balances.

ensure falls through to condition(_from,_value) for non-whitelisted addresses.
transferFrom executes the unchecked balanceOf/allowance mutations.
batchSend executes the unchecked total = _value * _tos.length computation.
_mints performs the arbitrary balance assignment.
delegate executes the raw delegatecall to an attacker-chosen target.
The delegatecall can reenter the token contract and re-execute state-mutating functions under the token's storage context.

transferFrom reads and decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender].
balanceOf is updated with raw -= and += operators, bypassing SafeMath.
allowance is decremented with the raw -= operator.
The _value parameter feeds the unchecked allowance and balance arithmetic.
approve writes the allowance mapping.

ensure whitelists _from == tradeAddress.
ensure whitelists any address flagged in canSale.
ensure returns true when _from == owner or _to == owner.
condition compares _value against _minSale.
condition compares _value against _maxSale.
condition checks _onSaleNum[_from] against _saleNum.
condition reads the per-address sale counter _onSaleNum.
The caller-supplied address a is the target of the delegatecall.
The caller-supplied bytes b is the calldata of the delegatecall.
_mints sets canSale[spender] = true.
_mints writes an arbitrary value into balanceOf[spender].
The spender parameter receives a minted balance with no supply accounting.
addedValue is directly scaled into the recipient balance without updating totalSupply.

init assigns _maxSale.
init assigns _saleNum.
token parameter scaled by 10**decimals into _minSale.
maxToken parameter scaled by 10**decimals into _maxSale.
saleNum parameter stored into _saleNum.

_value is multiplied by _tos.length without overflow protection.
_tos.length participates in the unchecked total computation and loop.

The addr parameter is stored directly into tradeAddress, granting whitelist bypass.

Constructor sets totalSupply from _supply.
